messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning a rolling reboot in az6 this Thu 02:00-05:00 UTC. Strategy: interleaved cohorts (small), egress shim to us-east1 for affected cohorts, and KV-cache reseed after each cohort. Targeting ~10% of GPU slots per cohort. Posting runbook below.

devon: cohort size? how many nodes per cohort?

maria: cohort ~8 nodes (~1k GPU slots). Expect 5 cohorts total. We picked that to keep p95 latency impact minimal.

angela: What about Dedicated customers pinned to az6? Any planned failover behavior?

maria: Dedicated pools pinned to az6 will be signalled for graceful drain; if they rely on strict locality we'll notify account reps. For most Dedicated customers we have reserved spare capacity in us-east1 to accept routed traffic. We'll also set a canary rule to prefer local pools until drain reaches 50%.

tim: Need quick cost estimate for cross-region egress and extra burst compute while backfilling.

anna-cost: rough numbers: ~3TB egress across the event (~3000 GB). At $0.09/GB => ~$270 egress. Burst backfill compute (temporary extra slots) ~200 GPU-hours => ~$1200. Ops budget will cover. :money_with_wings:

infra-bot: Maintenance scheduled by maria for 2025-11-12 02:00 UTC. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/az6-interleaved-reboot (access restricted).

maria: Runbook snippet:
```
1) cordon cohort nodes
2) drain non-critical long-running tasks (grpc/llm jobs -> retry)
3) soft-reboot BMC -> kernel -> drivers
4) uncordon + KV-cache reseed (warmup traffic to /generate)
5) validate p95/p99 latency and error-rate for 10m
```

sre-oncall: I'll perform canary traffic injection and watch traces. Ping me 30m before each cohort starts.

devon: Add `--warmup-prefix=preseed` to the warmup tool so we prime common prefixes. Also running kv-seed with `concurrency=8` reduces cold-first-token hit.

lei: Suggest adding fallback route policy to model-variant `small-quant` for memory-heavy requests during cohort windows to avoid OOMs. Also set model-variant fallback weight to 0.2 so not all traffic flips.

angela: Will you post to status page? Customers in az6-hosted and az6-dedicated should get a short comms.

maria: Yes — status page update T-60m and T-5m (brief note). Also internal ticket to account teams for customers with high pinned utilization.

tim: Any expected longer tail issues (KV cache cold after full event)?

maria: We'll run two rounds of KV reseed (immediate + 15m after cohort) and keep prefix cache TTL tuned. If p99 stays above threshold after 30m we'll rollback cohort and mark for manual investigation.

anna-cost: tagging costs to `ops:egress-az6-nov` for chargeback.

infra-bot: Post-checklist reminder 10m before start: `@sre-oncall`, `@devon`, `@maria`.

maria: Final ask: keep cohort window to 20m each (drain + reboot + reseed). If we see >5% error-rate spike, pause and escalate. :thumbsup:
